features.heading: Everything You Need to Build
features.subheading: A complete ecosystem for developers, instructors, freelancers, and teams.
features.tenantDesc: Strict subdomain-based data isolation with Prisma & MySQL. Each workspace is completely secure.
features.coursesDesc: Publish and monetize technical courses with module tracking, progress analytics, and certificates.
features.marketplaceDesc: Buy and sell components, templates, and API services with integrated PayPal payments.
features.jobsDesc: Post and apply to jobs with secure escrow payments. Protected transactions for both parties.
features.forumDesc: Discuss courses, products, and jobs. Get help from instructors, freelancers, and peers.
features.i18nDesc: Full i18n support with RTL layouts. English, Arabic, French, German, and Spanish ready.
